items.prompt: A bag has 12 marbles. Half of the marbles are red. One quarter of the marbles are blue.
hints: To find half, share into 2 equal groups.
To find a quarter, share into 4 equal groups.
12 shared into 2 is 6. 12 shared into 4 is 3.
items.explanation: Half of 12 is 6, so there are 6 red marbles. A quarter of 12 is 3, so there are 3 blue marbles. 6 is more than 3.
